sections.markdown:
RELATIONSHIP EDUCATION FOR COUPLES

One day workshop for married or committed couples who want to learn more about relationship safety and healthy vs. unhealthy relationships.

Topics include: communication, conflict, reflecting on your life/journey, expectations, hidden issues, commitment, and relationship goals.
